## Dragos Notifications Dashboard
---

This workbook gives security and OT teams one place to monitor Dragos Platform notifications ingested into Microsoft Sentinel. It shows how many notifications are arriving, how severe they are, which MITRE ATT&CK for ICS tactics and techniques they map to, which assets and collectors are involved, and how quickly detections are raised, so analysts can prioritize what needs attention first.

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| distinct SeverityLabel

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| summarize Notifications = count()
content.title: Total Notifications

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand quad = detectionQuads
| extend Quadrant = tostring(quad)
| where isnotempty(Quadrant)
| summarize Notifications = dcount(id) by Quadrant
| order by Notifications desc
content.title: Detection Quadrants

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand threat = threatInfo
| where tostring(threat.framework) == "MITRE ATT&CK FOR ICS"
| extend Tactic = tostring(threat.tactic.name)
| where isnotempty(Tactic) and Tactic != "N/A"
| summarize Notifications = dcount(id) by Tactic
| order by Notifications desc
content.title: MITRE ATT&CK for ICS Tactics

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand threat = threatInfo
| where tostring(threat.framework) == "MITRE ATT&CK FOR ICS"
| extend Tactic = tostring(threat.tactic.name), TechniqueId = tostring(threat.technique.id), TechniqueName = tostring(threat.technique.name)
| where isnotempty(TechniqueId)
| summarize Notifications = dcount(id) by Tactic, TechniqueId, TechniqueName
| order by Notifications desc
content.title: Top MITRE Techniques

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand asset = assets
| mv-expand address = asset.addresses
| where tostring(address.type) == "IP"
| extend IpAddress = tostring(address.value)
| summarize Notifications = dcount(id) by IpAddress
| top 10 by Notifications desc
content.title: Top Affected IP Addresses

DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand collector = collectors
| extend CollectorId = tostring(collector.collectorId)
| where isnotempty(CollectorId)
| summarize Notifications = dcount(id) by CollectorId
| order by Notifications desc
content.title: Notifications by Collector

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| extend LatencyMinutes = datetime_diff("minute", createdAt, occurredAt)
| summarize AvgLatencyMinutes = round(avg(LatencyMinutes), 1), MaxLatencyMinutes = max(LatencyMinutes) by bin(createdAt, 1d)
| order by createdAt asc
content.title: Detection Latency Trend

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| mv-expand threat = threatInfo
| where tostring(threat.framework) == "MITRE ATT&CK FOR ICS"
| extend Tactic = tostring(threat.tactic.name), TechniqueId = tostring(threat.technique.id), TechniqueName = tostring(threat.technique.name)
| where isnotempty(Tactic) and Tactic != "N/A"
| summarize
    Notifications = dcount(id),
    High = dcountif(id, SeverityLabel == "High"),
    Medium = dcountif(id, SeverityLabel == "Medium"),
    Low = dcountif(id, SeverityLabel == "Low"),
    Informational = dcountif(id, SeverityLabel == "Informational"),
    Unresolved = dcountif(id, state == "UNRESOLVED"),
    LastSeen = max(createdAt)
    by Tactic, TechniqueId, TechniqueName
| order by Tactic asc, Notifications desc
content.title: Tactics and Techniques

content.query:
DragosAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(createdAt, *) by id
| extend SeverityLabel = case(severity in (0, 1), "Informational", severity == 2, "Low", severity == 3, "Medium", severity in (4, 5), "High", "Unknown")
| where SeverityLabel in ({Severity}) and state in ({State})
| where SeverityLabel == "High"
| project createdAt, id, summary, SeverityLabel, state, reviewed, content
| order by createdAt desc
| take 50
content.title: Latest High-Severity Notifications
